title: RIVM GeoServer — full catalogue
note: Everything RIVM's GeoServer publishes: 16,161 named layers, mostly dashboard workspaces (dash:n2k alone is 10,033 Natura 2000 layers) that the themed alo/ank/dmg endpoints do not carry. Its capabilities document is 75 MB and takes ~30s to fetch, and enrichment is declined here: attribute schemas cost one request per layer, and 16,000 of those against a free public service is not a reasonable thing to do on every harvest. The themed endpoints stay listed separately because they are what the atlases actually publish.
